notes.title: "War On Space": Early Access Version 0.9.0.5 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders:

To continuously optimize the interstellar combat experience, 《Star Wars WarOS》has now released the Early Access Version 0.9.0.5 update. This update focuses on core feature iterations and detail refinement. Below are the specific details:


【Core Update Content】

  1. Optimized certain levels (balance and mission-related content).  
  2. Added a rear-view camera function for vehicles (press the spacebar to enable; once enabled, use the right mouse button to continuously fire advanced ammunition).  
  3. Optimized ship pathfinding functionality.  
  4. Enhanced scene rendering effects and special effects.  
  5. Added an opening video.  
  6. Fixed several bugs.


【Feedback Channels】  
If you encounter any issues or have optimization suggestions during your experience, please feel free to provide feedback through the official community (QQ Group: 894861758). Every suggestion will become an important milestone in optimizing Star Trek!  

【Commander's Message】  
May the new version of the starfield battlefield allow you to feel the immersive strategic charm when deploying fleets and planning galactic layouts. The next stop in the universe—let's explore together!

3. Optimized ship pathfinding functionality.

notes.title: WarOS Early Access Version 0.9.0.1 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]Dear Commanders:[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]In order to further optimise the gaming experience, we are pleased to announce the release of the Early Access Version 0.9.0.1 update. This update will bring several core feature upgrades and gameplay optimisations, as detailed below:[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]1. Added customisable control buttons for the main camera;[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]2. Optimised level experience, shortened level duration, and reduced difficulty;[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]3. Added scheduled production mode to the printer module;[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]4. Increased ground vehicle movement speed;[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]5. Comprehensively optimised level balance, adjusted turret base attributes, and adapted to the overall gameplay rhythm.[/p][p]﻿[/p][p]If you encounter any issues during gameplay or have valuable suggestions for the game, please feel free to provide feedback in the comment section. Every piece of feedback you provide will help WarOS embark on an even more perfect interstellar journey! May you enjoy the thrill of strategic planning and decisive victories in every battle across the vast cosmos![/p]

tags.feature: 1. Added customisable control buttons for the main camera;

tags.balance_change: 2. Optimised level experience, shortened level duration, and reduced difficulty;

tags.feature: 3. Added scheduled production mode to the printer module;

tags.balance_change: 5. Comprehensively optimised level balance, adjusted turret base attributes, and adapted to the overall gameplay rhythm.
